about: The customer API contract as the verification tooling holds it: BUILD-SPEC section 6 of the Fable coding build (client contract customer-2026-11-24) - GET /api/session, GET /api/encounters and GET /api/encounters/<id> - every key listed and nothing else (studio/customer.py builds them; tests/test_api_customer.py holds the server to this file). Read by ops/scan_customer.py and the walk, so a key the server adds fails them until this file is consciously extended. Beyond section 6: workspace.specialty in GET /api/session (the workspace category's name - Gastroenterology, Neurosurgery or Orthopedic Surgery - a label the page shows; owner direction 2026-11-22, D390), document.view_media_type (what the in-page view shows: application/pdf, text/plain, or null when nothing can be shown) and document.converted (true when the view is the PDF a Word document was converted to for the coding review, so its pages are the pages the quotes name), and the state and phase 'earlier' (an encounter the earlier system reviewed, with no coding round: retry codes it again). The fix pass (FIX-SPEC section 1): every code row carries its line (L1.. the reader's codes in order, M1.. the second check's additions), and its decision, quotes and allowed_actions are that line's; modifiers are null when the coding review gave none (shown 'not given'); a question names the lines it affects (lines) and shows those lines' codes (codes). Fix pass 2 (FIX-SPEC-2 section 5): a decision shown carries its id, which an undo (POST decisions, action revoke) names as decision, and an export (POST reports) names the round the page shows; either is answered 409 when it no longer matches. The physician PDF report (2026-11-21): an export is made as pdf only (studio.exports.FORMATS; owner direction 2026-11-21, no more TXT or CSV); a listed export made before that may be csv or txt, so the fmt enum keeps all three. Types: string, integer, number, boolean, any, date (YYYY-MM-DD), iso (an ISO 8601 timestamp); a trailing '?' allows null. A node is a type name, {"ref": NAME, "nullable": bool}, {"enum": [...], "nullable": bool}, {"items": NODE}, {"map": NODE} (any key, values of NODE) or {"keys": {...}, "nullable": bool} (exactly these keys). Release 1 (client contract customer-2026-11-24; RELEASE-1-SPEC C4 and C5): GET /api/session adds can_manage_team (true for an active owner: owners only see and change the team, owner decision D15); GET /api/members answers members (a practice's memberships, each a member: id, label, username, role, active - their access to this practice, the switch an owner turns - actor_kind, last_sign_in and password_change_required; username is a key the customer denylist forbids elsewhere, so a reader of this payload exempts it); POST /api/members/<id>/access {active: true|false} answers member_access ({member}); a refusal there is the usual {error, details} (403 for a reviewer or viewer, 404 for someone of another practice, 409 for your own access or the last active owner). Over a report, upload or bundle limit any API call answers 429 rate_limited ({error: rate_limited, retry_after: whole seconds}, with the same number in the Retry-After header): the page says it in its own words.
